en.title: Image Stream with Favorites First
en.description:
The image stream first returns all favorite images in the order of the favorites list, then returns the non-favorite images in the order of the original image list. getNext is called q times in a row; once the stream is exhausted, each call returns NULL. The lists do not change after construction.

The standard input/output, examples, and tests are written by CSWork; ranges marked "this site" are judging conventions and are not claimed to be original interview limits.
en.input: This site's standard input: the first line contains n m q (1≤n,q≤100000, 0≤m≤n); the second line contains n distinct image identifiers; the third line contains m distinct favorite identifiers, which form a subset of the original list. Identifiers consist of 1..32 English letters or digits, and NULL is not allowed.
en.output: Output the answer as described; results for multiple queries are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: Example 1: first output the favorites in order, i3, i1, then the non-favorites i2, i4; by the fifth call the stream is exhausted, so NULL is output. Example 2: there are no favorites, so the first call outputs a and the second NULL. Example 3: every image is a favorite, so b, a are output in the given favorites order.
hints: At construction, build only the favorites set and keep two cursors. Advance the favorites cursor first, then scan the original list skipping favorites, and output NULL once everything is exhausted.
